The Georgia knowledge test

  • You need 30 correct answers to pass (75%).
  • The state also gives the test in Spanish.

5 sample questions

1. In Georgia, what is the youngest age to get a learner's permit (Class CP)?

  1. 14 years old
  2. 15 years old (correct answer)
  3. 16 years old
  4. 17 years old

Answer: B. In Georgia you can get a Class CP learner's permit at 15, after you pass the vision and knowledge tests.

Georgia handbook, page 8.

2. In Georgia, what does the hands-free law say about holding a phone while driving?

  1. You may not hold the phone or support it with any part of your body (correct answer)
  2. You may hold it if you drive slowly
  3. You may hold it on city streets only
  4. You may hold it if you are over 21

Answer: A. Georgia's hands-free law makes it illegal for any driver to hold a phone or support it with any part of the body while driving.

Georgia handbook, page 25.

3. In Georgia, you are driving the opposite way from a stopped school bus with flashing lights and stop signs out, on a divided highway. What must you do?

  1. Stop until the bus moves
  2. Continue with caution; you do not have to stop (correct answer)
  3. Speed up to pass quickly
  4. Turn around

Answer: B. In Georgia, drivers going the opposite way on a divided highway do not have to stop for a school bus, but they must drive with caution.

Georgia handbook, page 44.

4. In Georgia, an emergency vehicle with flashing lights is parked on the shoulder. What does the Move Over Law require first, if it is safe?

  1. Honk to warn the workers
  2. Stop in your lane
  3. Move over one lane, away from the vehicle (correct answer)
  4. Drive on the shoulder

Answer: C. Georgia's Move Over Law requires you to move over one lane, away from the stopped emergency vehicle, when it is safe to do so.

Georgia handbook, page 18.

5. In Georgia, how old must the licensed person beside a learner's permit driver be?

  1. At least 16
  2. At least 18
  3. At least 25
  4. At least 21 (correct answer)

Answer: D. A Georgia permit driver must have a licensed person who is at least 21 years old in the car.

Georgia handbook, page 8.
